name: theme-factory
tagline_zh: 做好的幻灯片、文档、落地页，配色总像临时凑的？10套预设主题一键换肤，还能现场生成新风格，告别改稿到凌晨。
tagline_en: Tired of slides & docs that look thrown together? Apply 10 pro themes in one click, or generate a fresh style on.
desc_en: Toolkit for styling artifacts with a theme. These artifacts can be slides, docs, reportings, HTML landing pages, etc. There are 10 pre-set themes with colors/fonts that you can apply to any artifact that has been creating, or can generate a new theme on-the-fly.
why_zh: 同类工具只能套模板，它能边聊边生成新主题，且预设主题覆盖文档、幻灯片、网页三类产物，改完即用。
why_en: Unlike template-only tools, it generates new themes on demand and covers docs, slides, and web pages—apply and ship instantly.
